sections.text: EWSR1::PATZ1 has been identified in sarcomas with mixed neural and myogenic marker expression. The directly studied tumors expressed markers including S100/SOX10 and desmin or myogenic transcription factors.

report_comment.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription. PATZ1 encodes a zinc-finger transcriptional regulator with an AT-hook DNA-binding motif. EWSR1::PATZ1 has been identified in sarcomas with mixed neural and myogenic marker expression. The directly studied tumors expressed markers including S100/SOX10 and desmin or myogenic transcription factors.
